cases.title: New Android account uploads and opens standard encrypted text file
cases.expected: File name is readable after login and file opens without secure prompt.

cases.title: Existing web session restores standard file names after refresh
cases.expected: Names and thumbnails decrypt after refresh with no passphrase dialog.

cases.title: Wrong password does not unlock account data
cases.expected: Login fails and no file metadata or object data is shown.

cases.title: Secure file remains locked until secure mode passphrase is entered
cases.expected: List shows locked item and open action requests secure passphrase.

cases.title: Secure sharded binary downloads after secure mode unlock
cases.expected: All shards download, decrypt, and reassemble into original bytes.

cases.title: Legacy secured file decrypts with login key and becomes standard
cases.expected: Name appears automatically and metadata changes to standard encryption.

cases.title: Phone upload appears on already-open desktop app
cases.expected: Desktop live list updates and decrypts file name and thumbnail.

cases.title: Standard file can be saved for offline use
cases.expected: Offline copy opens after network is disabled.

cases.title: Interrupted upload does not create broken metadata
cases.expected: User sees failure, no unreadable partial file appears, retry succeeds.

cases.title: Folder upload keeps nested structure and encrypted names
cases.expected: Nested folders and files appear in correct location with readable names.

cases.title: Backup handles empty file without retry loop
cases.expected: Backup scan completes and records no corrupt object.

cases.title: Cloud-imported file can be renamed and deleted
cases.expected: Rename updates encrypted display name; delete removes metadata and object.

cases.title: Raw link sharing is blocked for encrypted files
cases.expected: Copy-link action refuses raw encrypted object URL.

cases.title: Secure file share exports decrypted copy only after unlock
cases.expected: Share/download works only after secure passphrase and output bytes match source.

cases.title: Deleting secure file removes all shard objects
cases.expected: Metadata disappears and every shard key is deleted.

cases.title: Secure uploads use passphrase-derived opaque shard paths
cases.expected: Uploaded shard keys are under the object parts prefix but do not reveal sequential indexes.

cases.title: Stale secure files prompt for non-blocking passphrase refresh
cases.expected: Overdue secure files show a refresh prompt, accept the passphrase locally, and update the next due date without blocking access.
